retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the package of European directives on electronic communications negotiated from 2007. It is an act of the Union rather than of Portugal, and the atlas has no lane for one; keeping it would mean inventing Portugal's particular part in it. The venue is not a causal fact: a treaty signed in Lisbon belongs to the history of what it settles.
